dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, light-grey crenulated perimeters. These boundaries define a gradient transition from the dark-grey exterior base coat to slightly lighter-grey interior cores, most visible in a cluster of three large annuli on the posterior-dorsal surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, solid light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed primarily around the neck and the anterior-ventral transition zone. These blobs are smaller and more amorphous than the dorsal annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the posterior dorsal flank form an obtuse triangle. A secondary grouping of four smaller annuli located on the mid-lateral surface forms an elongated irregular quadrilateral.
